title: Direct speech-to-speech translation with a sequence-to-sequence model
summary: Translatotron: an end-to-end model that maps speech in one language directly to speech in another, with no intermediate text step.

title: FastSpeech 2: Fast and High-Quality End-to-End Text to Speech
summary: Non-autoregressive TTS conditioned on explicit pitch, energy and duration predictors; a useful reference for controllable prosody.

title: Seamless: Multilingual Expressive and Streaming Speech Translation
summary: Adds expressivity (vocal style and prosody such as rate and pauses) and streaming to multilingual speech translation.
